verdict.rationale: Factory documents that the App creates and prepares a separate, isolated working directory for each session, and that Droid Computers keep installed packages and configuration between sessions. Together these suggest agent-managed environments, but the docs never explicitly say the agent clones the repo or installs dependencies on its own. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic repo cloning, agent-driven dependency installation, details of what 'prepares it' covers, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent automatically clone the repo, install dependencies, and configure its own working environment

citations.quote: The Factory App creates a separate working directory for the session, prepares it, and keeps it isolated from your other work.
Droid Computers **retain state**: installed packages, files, running services, and configuration all persist between sessions.
